description: This is a C# source code file defining two classes: CollectionTestGrain and ReentrantCollectionTestGrain, which are Orleans grains implementing collection-based behaviors, including activation, deactivation, counters, timers, and reentrancy features in a testing context.

classes.name: CollectionTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing collection testing logic with counters, timers, and activation/deactivation management.

classes.name: ReentrantCollectionTestGrain
classes.description: A reentrant version of the collection test grain, allowing reentrant calls, with additional logging and delay simulation.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, initializing loggers and counters.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation, logs the event.

methods.name: IncrCounter
methods.description: Increments both static and instance counters, logs the operation.

methods.name: GetAge
methods.description: Returns the time elapsed since activation.

methods.name: SetOther
methods.description: Sets a reference to another grain.

methods.name: GetOtherAge
methods.description: Retrieves the age of the 'other' grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to this grain.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer with specified period and delay.

methods.name: TimerCallback
methods.description: Timer callback that updates counters and logs.
